Subject: Acme renewal + expansion recap / next steps

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we have everything aligned.

Key takeaways from today
- Current usage: ~120M tokens/month across search and chat workloads; CPU/GPU mix is increasing as you adopt longer chat contexts.
- Pain points: latency spikes during EOW batch jobs, inconsistent costs on embeddings for search, and the need for stricter audit logs for compliance.
- Goals for renewal: lock in predictable unit economics for core chat + formalize plan to onboard new search workload (approx. +30% tokens).

Suggested expansion path
1) Renew current hosted plan for core chat with a 12-month commitment to stabilize pricing.
2) Add a dedicated pool for high-throughput search embeddings (start 3 GPUs, reserve burst capacity).
3) Enable Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + KV caching) to reduce token spend on search by an estimated 15-25%.

Deliverables / next steps
- I will share a draft proposal outlining pricing for the committed 12-month renewal + dedicated pool options (target: by EOD Thurs). [Marcus to provide final pricing]
- Rishi will follow up with a short onboarding checklist and timeline for the embeddings rollout (target: 2-3 week pilot).
- Samantha / Raj to confirm legal contact for contracting and any procurement timelines.
- Schedule: proposed follow-up call the week of Mar 2 to review proposal and finalize sizes.

Attachments: redwood_usage_report_acme_q1.xlsx (usage breakdown)

Thanks again — happy to jump on a quick call if you'd prefer to walk through the numbers.

Best,
